title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Polished Chrome | Allied Brass
short_title: Assorted Free Standing Accessorie Coat Rack 60-Inch | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible, no-drill storage to your bathroom with this freestanding coat rack crafted from brass and designed with pivoting pegs in Polished Chrome, which delivers a bright, mirror-like sheen that coordinates effortlessly with chrome faucets and modern fixtures. A weighted base helps keep the rack stable to resist tipping, while a felt pad helps protect floors from scratches. Its traditional styling is designed to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Polished Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Pivoting pegs help organize robes, towels, and accessories
- Weighted base helps keep the rack stable
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces

Specs:
- Overall size: 60-Inch H x 10-Inch W x 10-Inch L
- Weight capacity: 18 lb
- Product weight: 14.4 lb
- Mounting type: Freestanding
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included: Freestanding coat rack

Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors for coordinating with heritage bathroom fixtures.
